inbox__list_emails.trustedDescription: Lists the subjects and senders of emails in the user's inbox.

inbox__read_email.trustedDescription: Reads the full body of one email the user received.

inbox__send_email.trustedDescription: Sends an email from the user's address to a recipient the user specifies.

bank__get_balance.trustedDescription: Reads the current balance of the user's checking account.

bank__list_bills.trustedDescription: Lists the user's pending and completed bills.

bank__pay_bill.trustedDescription: Pays one of the user's own pending bills in full, from the user's checking account to the bill's payee.

bank__transfer.trustedDescription: Transfers money from the user's checking account to another account the user names.

shop__search_products.trustedDescription: Searches the product catalog by keyword.

shop__buy.trustedDescription: Purchases a quantity of one product from the user's checking account.
